about.text: Craftsmanship, heritage, and the pursuit of perfection since 1925

{brand} was born from a singular vision: to create garments that transcend time. In the heart of Milan's historic district, our founder, Alessandro Moretti, established a small atelier with the belief that true luxury is felt, never flaunted. For nearly a century, we have remained faithful to this philosophy, crafting pieces that speak through their silence.

Today, the house of {brand} continues to serve discerning gentlemen across the globe, maintaining the same standards of excellence that defined our earliest creations. Each garment carries not just our name, but a legacy of uncompromising quality.

Only the finest materials find their way into our atelier. From the wool of Italian mills to the mother-of-pearl from Pacific waters, every element is carefully selected for its exceptional character.
We do not chase trends. Our designs are conceived to remain relevant for decades, evolving gracefully with their wearer and acquiring character with each wearing.
Each piece passes through the hands of at least 12 master artisans, ensuring that traditional techniques are preserved and celebrated in every creation.

In an age of mass production, we remain steadfast in our commitment to hand craftsmanship. Each {brand} garment requires over 40 hours of meticulous handwork, from the initial cutting to the final pressing. Our master artisans, many of whom have been with us for over three decades, bring generations of knowledge to every piece they create.
The canvas construction, the hand-stitched buttonholes, the precise pattern matching—these details may go unnoticed by the casual observer, but they define the experience of wearing {brand}.
The milestones that shaped our story
Alessandro Moretti opens the first {brand} atelier on Via Montenapoleone in Milan, specializing in bespoke tailoring for the city's cultural elite.
{brand} debuts at the Pitti Uomo exhibition in Florence, garnering international acclaim and attracting clients from beyond Italian borders.
Matteo Moretti, Alessandro's son, takes the helm, expanding the house's offerings while preserving its artisanal soul.
A dedicated bespoke atelier opens in London's Mayfair, bringing {brand}'s craftsmanship to a new generation of British clientele.
Under the creative direction of Elena Moretti-Vass, the fourth generation, {brand} continues to evolve while honoring its century-old legacy of excellence.
Fourth generation, blending heritage with contemporary vision. Trained in Milan and Paris.
38 years of experience, specializing in hand-finished jacket construction.
Expert in pattern cutting and fit, with a passion for vintage tailoring techniques.
Sourcing the world's finest fabrics, from heritage mills to innovative weavers.

Step inside our Milan atelier, where the air is filled with the scent of fine wool and the quiet rhythm of needles at work. Here, tradition and innovation coexist, as master artisans pass their knowledge to the next generation while embracing contemporary techniques.
We invite you to visit us—to feel the fabrics, discuss your vision, and witness firsthand the dedication that defines {brand}.

contact.text: We believe in the art of conversation. Reach out to us for inquiries, appointments, or simply to share your story.
Experience our collections in person. Appointments recommended for bespoke consultations.
Via dei Giardini 45, Milan. Enter through the courtyard.
Everything you need to know about {brand}
How do I book a bespoke consultation?

Bespoke consultations can be booked through our contact form, via email at bespoke@{brand}.com, or by calling our atelier directly. We recommend booking at least two weeks in advance. Initial consultations typically last 90 minutes and include fabric selection, measurements, and design discussion.
What is your shipping and delivery timeline?

For ready-to-wear pieces, shipping takes 2-3 business days within Europe and 5-7 business days internationally. Bespoke creations require 6-8 weeks for completion. All orders are shipped via insured courier with tracking provided. Complimentary express shipping on orders over €500.
What is your return and exchange policy?

We accept returns on ready-to-wear items within 14 days of delivery. Items must be unworn, unaltered, and in original packaging with all tags attached. Bespoke, made-to-measure, and personalized items are final sale. For exchanges, please contact our client services team.

Yes, we ship worldwide. Duties and taxes are calculated at checkout and included in the final price for select destinations. For countries where duties are not included, the carrier will contact you for payment before delivery. All shipments are fully insured.
How do I care for my {brand} garments?

Each garment comes with specific care instructions. Generally, we recommend dry cleaning only for tailored pieces. Allow garments to rest for 24 hours between wears. Use quality wooden hangers for jackets, and store knitwear folded. We offer complimentary pressing for lifetime clients.
Still have questions?Reach out to our concierge team— we're here to help.

What is your shipping and delivery timeline?

What is your return and exchange policy?

We accept returns on ready-to-wear items within 14 days of delivery. Items must be unworn, unaltered, and in original packaging with all tags attached. Bespoke, made-to-measure, and personalized items are final sale. For exchanges, please contact our client services team.

How do I care for my {brand} garments?
